result.title: RetinaGuard: Risk-Controlled Agentic Triage for Multi-Disease Retinal Screening
result.summary: Retinal screening programmes need to know which automated decisions can be accepted without review. This paper presents RetinaGuard, an agentic triage framework in which quality, diagnostic, uncertainty, verification and explanation agents gather evidence for each fundus photograph, a learned failure predictor estimates the probability that the decision is unsafe, auxiliary tools are invoked only when their expected value of information exceeds their cost, and the acceptance threshold is certified by conformal risk control. On the RFMiD test split, RetinaGuard was compared with confidence and calibrated-uncertainty referral at matched referral budgets and equal certified safety, using two RETFound primary models of different strength. With the weaker model (macro-AUROC 0.896), verifier disagreement added significant information, RetinaGuard captured 119 of 280 unsafe decisions at a 20% budget against 88 for lowest-confidence referral, and at a nominal 5% unsafe level it accepted 37.0% of cases against 10.3%. With the stronger model (0.925) the verifier added nothing beyond uncertainty and the advantage shrank to a few percentage points. In both settings its coverage at the nominal 5% level stayed near 37.7%, gating cut computation by about 30%, and a quality agent reduced unsafe acceptances under most image corruptions. The benefit of agentic evidence gathering thus depends on how much the primary model's own uncertainty already reveals about its errors.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RetinaGuard，一个用于眼底多病种筛查的 agentic 分诊框架：多个质量、诊断、不确定性、验证与解释代理为每张图收集证据，学习式失败预测器估计决策不安全的概率，仅当辅助工具的期望信息价值超过成本时调用，并用保形风险控制校准接受阈值。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「期望信息价值超过成本才调用工具」与基于保形风险控制的可接受/弃权阈值，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 的证据获取和 STOP 的停止决策提供可核查的门控与风险校准线索；但工作面向医学分诊，未涉及 latent 推理状态。另可留意其发现：验证代理的增益取决于主模型自身不确定性已揭示的错误比例，这对判断额外视觉证据何时真正有用有参考价值。
